review:
The Merge Up sequel, with better graphics, three bonus buys, and multipliers and bombs in the base game. Four or more matching symbols form a cluster, pay, then part of it vanishes and the rest upgrades a level – nine levels, with the scatter as level ten.

Winning cells get marked: a win on a marked cell gets 2x, and it grows by 2x every time. Very high volatility and a 10,000x max (double the original), 97% RTP. Free spins are rarer than in Merge Up, about once every 409 spins. A clear upgrade.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 409 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
